note: Fragments read: an 1897 New York Times account of a 'concrete flooring of a pit of 13 feet long, 9 feet wide, and 8 feet deep'; the body in a 'lead-lined box wrapped in tar paper' with 'an inch of asphaltum'; the fears behind it, 'a lot of high-profile grave robberies lately', and that 'some of the employees weren't quite done getting revenge'; and Selzer's 'Whether it's true or not, we don't really know.'
